messages:
ravi-csm: Quick sync 1: We discovered an onboarding ingestion delay that impacted ~110 tenants across regions. About 22 are within 90 days of renewal. Proposing a careful comms approach: calm lead line, targeted 1:1s for at-risk tenants, short localized workshops, and a suggested goodwill credit framework. Thoughts?

tess-cs: Agree. Keep customer-facing copy very short. Lead with 'If search is normal, no action required.' Offer a 30-45m remediation slot and a recorded replay. For renewals within 90 days, propose proactive 1:1 outreach.

omar-eng: Root cause: concurrent backfill jobs during a rolling deploy caused ingestion throttling. Mitigation is live; queue replayed with rate limits. No evidence of vector loss. Recommend explicit guidance: DO NOT re-run full reindex unless support advises.

keiko-ops: Ops can run workshop slots next week: APAC mornings and EMEA afternoons. I'll create separate calendar links per region and an auto-ticket rule that opens INC-ONBOARD-3112 when customers request 1:1s.

lucy-ps: For renewal risk, suggest bands: small = $50, medium = $250, large = $600 (USD credits) as a starting point — CS to refine per-account usage. Finance gave provisional OK for this banding.

ravi-csm (draft message): ```Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to follow up about a temporary onboarding delay that affected embedding indexing for a small number of tenants. Engineers have mitigated the issue and we have not observed data loss.
If your search results look normal, no action is required. If you see missing results or inconsistent behavior, please schedule a 30-minute remediation slot here: <regional_cal_link>. We are offering a complimentary localized workshop and a small goodwill credit for customers in upcoming renewal windows.
Thanks, Ravi (Customer Success)```

tess-cs: Add FAQ bullet: "Data retention unaffected; do not reindex unless instructed." Also add a one-line diagnostic customers can run.

omar-eng: Diagnostic (single-line CURL) to include: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/stats | jq .vector_count`

keiko-ops: Action items: 1) ravi finalize email and regional calendar links by EOD; 2) tess to prepare EN/FR/DE/JP short emails and 30s language clips; 3) omar confirm and publish diagnostic endpoint docs by tonight; 4) lucy to draft proposed credits per account and hand back top-20 renewal-risk list.

support-bot: Created ticket group INC-ONBOARD-3112 and will tag any 1:1 requests automatically.

lucy-ps: I'll publish the prioritized list (renewal <30d, 30-90d, >90d) by 19:30 PT with suggested credit amounts.

ravi-csm: Good. Also planning a 2-question post-session survey: 1) Was your issue resolved? (yes/no) 2) Any remaining asks? (free text). Keep short to improve response rate.

tess-cs: Agree. For high-touch accounts we'll include an optional NPS question after the remediation call.

omar-eng: I'll provide a short appendix for the RCA link to include in footer for customers who want technical details. Recommend we publish the RCA publicly once internal review is complete.

keiko-ops: Ops will standby to escalate top flagged renewals into dedicated 1:1s within 24 hours of a customer reply.

ravi-csm: Plan timeline: send first wave to <30d renewal cohort tomorrow 08:00 local time. If anyone can't meet the timeline, flag now. Otherwise we'll send and monitor replies for urgent escalations.

tess-cs: I'll prep the localized copies and upload to CS repo. Ping this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
